Request validation had passed in 4 ms, so the request input was not the cause.

troubleshooting_steps: Check the payment gateway health: it returned 503 (service unavailable) to the upstream call.
Review order_views.py line 88, where payment_client.charge(order) raised InternalServerError.
Track request req-5f9a21 (trace trc-b21e48d7) to confirm the failure path.

expected_resolution: The payment gateway recovers and stops returning 503, POST /api/orders succeeds end-to-end, and the 5xx rate drops back below the threshold of 10 errors per 300 seconds.
